changes: Converted from the official PDF to Markdown by the your5e/5e-srd-markdown project, which lists its own changes: it gave class tables with several header rows a single header row; added a “Traits” heading to stat blocks; fixed the “Components” typo in Contagion; set “Petrifying Gaze” in bold italics like other traits; split the Armor, Saddles, Scrying, Tack, Harness, and Drawn Vehicles and Weapons tables at their mid-table headings; moved each pantheon’s table of deities into its description; added subclass introduction headings to the Barbarian, Bard, Cleric and Druid; and laid out the monster ability tables as score, modifier and saving throw in place of the Saving Throws line. mistLAB converted that Markdown to HTML and JSON, reformatted and indexed it, and, checked against the official PDF, restored what the Markdown had dropped: seven spell-list entries (Heroes’ Feast for the Cleric and Druid, Hunter’s Mark for the Ranger, Enlarge/Reduce for the Sorcerer and Wizard, Arcanist’s Magic Aura and Control Weather for the Wizard), the Grimlock’s Blind Senses trait, the Jokers row of the Deck of Illusions table, the Cleric Level column of the Destroy Undead table and the Saving Throws line of each stat block. It also made “Meat, chunk” its own row of the Food, Drink, and Lodging table as printed, set the Warlock table’s “Bonus Proficiency” heading back to “Proficiency Bonus” as printed, rejoined “Tent, two-person” and removed stray italics around punctuation. Apart from formatting and these changes, no rules text was changed.

Different kinds of insects can gather in swarms, and each swarm has the special characteristics described below.

Swarm of Beetles. A swarm of beetles gains a burrowing speed of 5 feet.

Swarm of Centipedes. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a swarm of centipedes is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

Swarm of Spiders. A swarm of spiders has the following additional traits.

Spider Climb. The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Web Sense. While in contact with a web, the swarm knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

Web Walker. The swarm ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Swarm of Wasps. A swarm of wasps has a walking speed of 5 feet, a flying speed of 30 feet, and no climbing speed.
